description: Canonical Think mind containing three healthy captures with their derived layer intact.

healthy.text: Warp worldlines keep browse startup fast because reads stay bounded.
Capture is a trapdoor: raw text in, immutable entry out, no retrieval first.

expected.note: Every capture is durable and readable through inspect, with its derived layer present: canonicalThought.stored is true and sessionAttribution is populated. A deferred capture was deliberately left out because that state is not reproducible - the abandoned followthrough usually completes before the tarball is written.
